source.name: U.S. Bancorp - NFL and U.S. Bank Announce Partnership Centered on Banking and Wealth Management
source.quote: The National Football League and U.S. Bank announced today a multi-year partnership, naming U.S. Bank as a new official bank and wealth management sponsor of the NFL.

note: Multi-year league partnership from 2026: U.S. Bank is presenting sponsor of the Super Bowl MVP Award (from Super Bowl LXI) and a top-tier sponsor of the NFL FLAG Championships. The 49ers' own U.S. Bank deals are separate records.
